notation: Logical Arabic in the BMG notation (text.bmg, engines.phantom_hourglass). Keep every escape and line end of the original, in order: {01:0A00nnnn} and {01:0E00nnnn} make the typewriter wait nnnn frames, {01:1400nnnn} sets its pace, {FF:00000300} colours a name blue and {FF:00000000} ends it. The box shows three lines, and every third line end starts a new page, so each line stays where it is; words may move between the lines of a page. A line holds at most 206 pixels. A line holds Arabic, spaces and punctuation (. ! : ، ؛ ؟) only: no Latin letters, since every glyph of a line is drawn right to left. No vowel marks: the font has none.
